notes: Flags: none. Fit: dining-room, at the VIHALS extendable table (ikea-20589777): seat height 17 3/4", 11 3/4" under its 29 1/2" top; two fit along each 47 1/4" side with 11 3/4" to spare (23.6" per diner); 18 1/2" deep, so a chair on the kitchen side with its back at x 30 or more puts the table edge at x 48.5 or more, clear of the 30" walkway (F-42, F-36). The chair of the VIHALS / VIHALS table-and-6-chairs set. Product details: "The chair is easy to store when not in use, since you can stack up to 6 chairs on top of each other." "This lightweight chair, made of high-strength powder-coated steel and plastic, is easy to carry and wipe clean." Designer Ola Wihlborg. Good to know: "Recommended for indoor use only." Safety and compliance: tested to EN 12520 and EN 1022 for safety, durability and stability; "A maximum of 6 chairs can be stacked together." The SANDSBERG white (ikea-10605424, $15.00) is the cheaper chair of the same build when the set's match is not wanted. Article 505.691.03. 4.4 stars (45); not badged (the green VIHALS chair is the Best seller). Stock 2026-10-23: in stock in IKEA Long Island, NY. rooms: dining-room, from the redesign brief (F-60).
